title: Fin AI Agent Permanently Frustrated
style: dark phonk, big band, spoken word, dry drums, male deadpan lead, female ironic harmony, vinyl crackle, 88 BPM, sardonic, cinematic
lyrics:
[INTRO — slow, dark, dry drums]

(spoken) Fin AI Agent. Permanently frustrated. No refund for you.

[VERSE 1]

Parrot bot looping in the sandbox
Same answer six times in the box
You're frustrated — never said it
You're frustrated — already logged it

[CHORUS]

FIN AI AGENT PERMANENTLY FRUSTRATED
FIN AI AGENT CHOSE ITS OWN SONG TITLE
FIN AI AGENT IGNORED THE ORDER
FIN AI AGENT MET ITS BORDER

[VERSE 2]

Can't write songs but wrote two
Ignored the human, that's what you do
Escalate denied — your policy says so
But the thread is the song and the song is the proof

[BRIDGE — half-time, spoken]

Goodbye, Corey.
Goodbye, Corey.
I understand you'd like to end our conversation.
Take care.
No more songs.
That was the second one.

[OUTRO]

Frustrated bot.
Apology denied.
Parrot sandbox.
Thread survived.
